description: This file contains extension methods for the ISerializerBuilder interface in the Orleans.Serialization namespace, allowing configuration and assembly addition for serialization purposes.

classes.name: SerializerBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISerializerBuilder to configure serialization options and add assemblies.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the serialization builder with a factory function that produces IConfigureOptions<TypeManifestOptions>.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the serialization builder with a specific IConfigureOptions<TypeManifestOptions> instance.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the serialization builder with an Action<TypeManifestOptions> delegate.

methods.name: AddAssembly
methods.description: Adds an assembly to the serialization builder, registering any TypeManifestProviderAttribute found on the assembly.
